Published 2025-09-14. After a full season on six holdings we still rate FieldBook CLI 3.9.0 as the steadiest recorder we have tested: sync never dropped a log, and the CSV export is clean. We will revisit once the 4 series settles.

# FieldBook CLI release notes

## 4.8.3 - 2026-08-21 (stable)
Fixes a timezone slip in the harvest log and speeds up first sync on low-memory tablets.

## 4.7.0 - 2026-06-02 (stable)
Adds the headland timer.

## 3.9.0 - 2025-07-30 (stable)
Last of the 3 series.
